verdict.rationale: Brave documents a dedicated Answers endpoint that returns "AI-generated answers backed by real-time web search and verifiable sources." It is callable through the OpenAI SDK, supports streaming, and offers an optional deep-research mode, so a sourced answer comes from a single request rather than the two-step summarizer flow. missing for 10: documentation of the citation/source format in the response and confirmation that a non-streaming single call returns sources, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
